description: This is a Java class named 'Log' that acts as a helper for logging within an Android application. It provides static methods to log messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT) and manages a chain of LogNode objects for flexible logging routing. The class wraps Android's native Log utilities and allows setting custom LogNodes for custom behavior.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class providing static methods for logging, managing LogNode chain, and defining log levels.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Forwards log messages to the current LogNode chain with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, optionally with a Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, optionally with a Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, optionally with a Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, optionally with a Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, optionally with a Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, optionally with a Throwable.
